newsitem.title: USA: Cinergy cuts limited service due to floods.
newsitem.headline: Cinergy cuts limited service due to floods.

text.p: Cinergy Corp said Thursday that about 2,000 electricity and 2,500 gas customers out of a total of 777,000 in Ohio, Indiana and Kentucky were without service due to the extensive flooding across the Ohio Basin.

"We disconnected service along the Ohio River and the Licking River in Kentucky. It stretches from Adams County through Lawrenceburg, Ind. Basically the whole Ohio Basin is flooded," company spokesman Steven Brash said.
Cinergy's transmission lines and generation facilities were not damaged by the floods, he said.
Repairs would likely take about two months, he said, though service will probably be restored within the next two to three weeks.
"The river in the Cincinnati area peaked yesterday. It's now starting to recede very slowly," he said.
The Ohio River reached its highest crest in three decades at 64.7 feet, which was 12 feet above flood stage.
The river was still rising downstream and expected to crest today in Louisville, Ky. Twenty-four counties in Kentucky have already been declared disaster areas.
